subject.name: Image Processing and Computer Vision
subject.title: CS-803 (A) - Image Processing and Computer Vision

modules.title: Introduction to CVIP and Morphological Processing
topics: Basics of CVIP, History of CVIP, Evolution of CVIP, CV Models
Image Filtering, Image Representations, Image Statistics
Recognition Methodology: Conditioning, Labeling, Grouping, Extracting, and Matching
Morphological Image Processing: Introduction, Dilation, Erosion, Opening, Closing, Hit-or-Miss transformation
Morphological algorithm operations on binary images, Morphological algorithm operations on gray-scale images
Thinning, Thickening, Region growing, region shrinking

modules.title: Image Representation and Binary Machine Vision
topics: Representation schemes, Boundary descriptors, Region descriptors
Binary Machine Vision: Thresholding, Segmentation, Connected component labeling
Hierarchal segmentation, Spatial clustering, Split & merge, Rule-based Segmentation, Motion-based segmentation
Area Extraction: Concepts, Data-structures, Edge, Line-Linking, Hough transform, Line fitting, Curve fitting (Least-square fitting)

modules.title: Region Analysis and Matching Frameworks
topics: Region properties, External points, Spatial moments, Mixed spatial gray-level moments
Boundary analysis: Signature properties, Shape numbers
General Frame Works For Matching: Distance relational approach, Ordered structural matching, View class matching, Models database organization

modules.title: Facet Model Recognition and Image Matching
topics: Labeling lines, Understanding line drawings
Classification of shapes by labeling of edges, Recognition of shapes
Consisting labeling problem, Back-tracking Algorithm
Perspective Projective geometry, Inverse perspective Projection, Photogrammetric - from 2D to 3D
Image matching: Intensity matching of ID signals, Matching of 2D image, Hierarchical image matching
Object Models And Matching: 2D representation, Global vs. Local features

modules.title: Knowledge Based Vision and Object Recognition
topics: Knowledge representation, Control-strategies, Information Integration
Object recognition - Hough transforms and other simple object recognition methods
Shape correspondence and shape matching
Principal component analysis, feature extraction
Neural network and Machine learning for image shape recognition
